note: Which governed projects THIS ProjectOS installation is willing to spend its own OpenAI gatekeeper credential on. This is an installation technical policy, not an owner gate: it is one of two required factors, and the other — the project's own committed secrets-handling receipt — remains entirely separate. Neither factor alone releases the credential. An entry here does NOT approve credential use for any phase; it only says the installation is willing to consider a project's own owner approval at all.

trustBasis: MANUAL_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL, tamperProof false. The runtime reads this file from the installation's git object store, never from the working tree, so it has no effect until COMMITTED — and an entry nobody authorised is a visible diff in the installation's own history. Wildcards are refused by the reader, so this list cannot be widened to 'all projects' by editing it.

projects.note: ProjectOS governing itself. Derived from `git remote get-url origin` in C:\dev\ProjectOS and canonicalised with the same parseRemoteUrl rule discovery and the observation check use. The governedRoot is part of the identity: origin lives in .git/config, which a project can rewrite, so a copy of this repository at any other path is a different project however it describes itself.
